command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$P40='GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
$RTX='GPU-6d9ae165-7272-a38c-06b1-7276869e980f'
$IMG='ollama/ollama:latest'
function Try-Run($label, $gpuArgs) {
  Write-Output "--- $label ---"
  $tmp = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
  $args = @('run','--rm') + $gpuArgs + @('--entrypoint','nvidia-smi',$IMG,'-L')
  $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'docker' -ArgumentList $args -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.out" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.err"
  Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
  Write-Output "STDOUT:"; Get-Content "$tmp.out" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Write-Output "STDERR:"; Get-Content "$tmp.err" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Remove-Item "$tmp","$tmp.out","$tmp.err" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Try-Run 'T1-ALL-GPUS'  @('--gpus','all')
Try-Run 'T2-RTX-ONLY'  @('--gpus',"device=$RTX")
Try-Run 'T3-P40-ONLY'  @('--gpus',"device=$P40")
Write-Output '--- NVIDIA-RUNTIME-PRESENT ---'
& docker info --format '{{json .Runtimes}}' 2>&1
